Jordan (Sales): FYI Wavefront RFI — they asked for a capability matrix, PoC pricing estimate, and network diagram by EOD Friday. Also called out burst capacity guarantees and HSM support.
Mira (Eng-ML): Quick clarifying q: when they say "burst" do they mean concurrent sessions, QPS, or tokens/s? Any sample traffic profile?
Jordan (Sales): They said 100 concurrent sessions steady, with spikes to ~400 qps for ~30s every hour. Target p95 <200ms for 2k token seq on gen endpoint. They also want quantization/FP16 support and latency SLOs in the matrix.
Sam (Eng-Platform): We can hit that with Dedicated + autoscale if we reserve a 2x baseline. Suggest we call out fallback path: hosted model variant (smaller quantized) with automatic routing when Dedicated is saturated.
Emma (Security): For HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). For on-prem HSM we offer Private with PKCS#11 support. I'll drop the exact references to the security questionnaire: sec q 3.2 (KMS/HSM), 4.1 (audit logs), 5.3 (data residency).
Jordan (Sales): They also asked for PoC cost for a 2-week trial: 100 concurrent steady, spikes as above, ~100k tokens/day. Any rough $$$ to ballpark for the RFI response?
Alex (Finance): Ballpark: Dedicated baseline (reserved) at ~$2.8k/day for the node pool we'd need; autoscale burst hours add ~ $0.45/minute when active. For a 2-week PoC with projected burst pattern expect ~ $40k total. I'll annotate costs per line in the matrix.
Mira (Eng-ML): I'll draft the capability matrix: rows = feature, latency SLO, model variants, quantization, KV/prefix caching, routing/fallback, telemetry, audit log retention, KMS/HSM. Filename: wavefront_cap_matrix_v1.xlsx (will attach). Planning to include a short decision note per row.
Jordan (Sales): Also need network diagram (VPC peering, egress rules) and signed NDA before we share infra details. @Emma can you confirm which legal contact to use?
Emma (Security): Use legal@redwood.com and include NDA template v3. I can sign as security attest for certs. I'll add the questionnaire answers inline.
Sam (Eng-Platform): Uploading preflight checklist and network diagram to the thread now.
deploy-bot: Document uploaded: /files/wavefront/network-diagram-v1.png
Jordan (Sales): Great — once Mira posts the matrix I'll stitch answers into the RFI doc and send to Wavefront. Thanks all :thumbsup:
